findings.title: Protect the manifest output from overwriting the source installation
findings.description: The CLI accepts arbitrary --output and build() calls output.write_text without a source-alias or game-root check. Choosing the original DLL path (or any installed game file) overwrites it with JSON even while status is blocked, bypassing protections in patch_native_copy. This contradicts the generator no-DLL-write boundary.
findings.reproduction: Static code path only: --output SOURCE_DLL reaches output.write_text after successful read/validation. Destructive reproduction deliberately not executed.
findings.recommendation: Reject canonical source aliases and all protected installation roots before writing; restrict the artifact extension to .json or otherwise enforce the intended output destination. Keep default manifest regeneration permitted.
findings.resolution: Generator preflights safe_review_output: source DLL extension, protected inputs, installation roots, hard links and symlink/junction ancestry rejected. Direct read-only actual-path checks passed; default manifest regeneration remains allowed.

limitations: No runtime safety, rendering throughput or complete native reference coverage established.623 large memory sites remain unproved; mode0 Single guard and job/lifetime contracts remain explicit blockers.
